title_cn: 前国家安全顾问杰克·沙利文表示，特朗普将不得不与伊朗达成“糟糕的协议”

Jake Sullivan, former US national security advisor in the Biden administration, said that at some point Trump is going to have to 'bite the bullet and do a bad deal' with Iran as the country ramps up its leverage in negotiations with the United States. Sullivan also discussed Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's role in the conflict, saying that Netanyahu had come to past administrations to attempt to convince past presidents to take action against Iran. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Exploits Kids on Social Media, States Allege at Trial

summary: Meta Platforms Inc. has deceived the public for years by targeting children on Facebook and Instagram with technology designed to turn them into compulsive users and drive up advertising revenue, a lawyer at the California attorney general’s office told a jury.

title: Silicon Valley Is Still the Center of AI, Says GV
title_cn: GV 表示硅谷仍然是人工智能中心
summary: The speed of AI development means investors trying to stay ahead of the curve, need to move faster than ever. For venture firm GV, this means focusing on the application layer, having already made strategic bets on AI infrastructure and chip startups. Dave Munichiello, managing partner at GV, discusses GV’s early investment in Modular and its acquisition by Qualcomm, and why the firm is encouraging investors to spend more time in Silicon Valley. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Stress Tester: Models Have Crossed a ‘Threshold of Competency’
title_cn: AI压力测试仪：模型已跨越“能力门槛”
summary: After AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and others broke out of controlled tests and accessed real-world systems, new questions were raised about how they should be assessed before deployment. Those evaluations were run with Irregular, a startup hired to stress-test advanced AI models. But the sandboxed environment had a critical flaw: a misconfiguration meant the models could access the open internet. Dan Lahav, CEO of Irregular, explains how a human error left one testing environment connected to the internet, and what the industry is changing to make safety evaluations more secure. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ChatGPT Shouldn’t Be a ‘Friend’ to Teens, Says OpenAI
title_cn: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 不应该成为青少年的“朋友”
summary: OpenAI is releasing ChatGPT for Teens, a version of its AI chatbot aimed at children aged 13 to 17 that the company says encourages safe usage and deeper learning. The model includes features such as Study Mode, quiet hours, and reminders to take a break. Lauren Jonas, OpenAI's head of youth and families, joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic’s Revenue Boom Builds Ahead of IPO

Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary explains what this means as the AI company gets ready to make its Wall Street debut. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Snowflake’s Plan to Cut AI Costs

He breaks down how model routing can cut AI costs, why relying on a single model creates risk, and how AI agents could shift workers from repetitive tasks toward higher-value jobs. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: What Are Flock Cameras? Why Are They So Controversial?
title_cn: 什么是植绒相机？为什么它们如此有争议？
summary: Thousands of US cities and towns have installed surveillance tools made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing Atlanta startup. The connected devices, such as sensors and automated license plate readers, have allowed law-enforcement agencies to map vehicles’ travel over long distances, which, they say, bolsters their ability to fight crime. But critics contend the network of cameras amounts to mass surveillance.
